content.comment_body: I recently received a [product_name] with article number [article_no] and noticed the display language is set to Chinese. How can I change it to English?

Your [product_name] includes a display that lets you change the menu language to English. Since it's set to Chinese, you’ll need to navigate the menus without reading them. Press the Down arrow key repeatedly until you reach the start-up screen (showing date and time). Then press the ESC key to access the menu. The next steps depend on whether the device is in RUN or STOP mode: If in RUN mode: - Select the third menu item, press OK. - Select the fifth menu item (under LCD), press OK. - Select the second menu item ("English"), press OK. The menu now displays in English. If in STOP mode: - Select the third menu item, press OK. - Select the eighth menu item (under LCD), press OK. - Select the second menu item ("English"), press OK. The menu now displays in English.
That solved the issue! The display language is now set to English. Thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: A user received a [product_name] device with its display language preset to Chinese, which made initial configuration difficult. Instructions were provided for navigating the language settings menu without needing to understand the current display language. The process worked, demonstrating that the product supports language change flexibly even in unfamiliar menu conditions. However, it highlights the inconvenience of receiving a device with a non-local default language.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped for a straightforward way to switch the display language from Chinese to English, ideally without prior knowledge of or ability to read the current language settings.
